name: HoneycombBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a honeycomb coral structure. The object shows the raw geometry of a tall rounded dome with a deeply pitted, cellular surface generated from a reaction-diffusion or Voronoi process. Without any texture or material color applied, the white mesh clearly reveals the shallow concave cells and raised ridges covering the dome surface, with a dark shadow fringe at the base where the geometry meets the ground plane.
